reference_sql:
SELECT s.store_code,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00') AS orders_2024,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00') AS orders_2025
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.store_code
alternatives:
SELECT store_code, "2024" AS orders_2024, "2025" AS orders_2025
FROM (
  -- one row per order of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT s.store_code, year(o.order_ts) AS yr
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
) AS y
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR yr IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY store_code)

SELECT s.store_code,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year(o.order_ts) = 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year(o.order_ts) = 2025 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_2025
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.store_code

other_way.sql:
SELECT store_code, "2024" AS orders_2024, "2025" AS orders_2025
FROM (
  -- one row per order of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT s.store_code, year(o.order_ts) AS yr
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
) AS y
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR yr IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY store_code)
other_way.tradeoff: PIVOT with an IN list of the two years is short, but only DuckDB runs it; the filtered counts run on any engine.
